abstract: Forty-three patients with the androgen insensitivity syndrome (AIS), ages 14 to 83 (average 27) years, were studied. Forty patients had complete AIS and three patients had incomplete AIS. Microscopic examination of the testes revealed immature tubules, which contained rare spermatogonia in 28% of the cases. Prominent Leydig cells and a spindle-cell stroma resembling ovarian stroma were found in a majority of cases. The organization of the testicular parenchyma could be classified into one of four patterns: diffuse tubulostromal, lobular tubulostromal, mixed tubulostromal, or stromal-predominant. Hamartomas were present in 63% and Sertoli cell adenomas in 23% of the cases. Malignant tumors developed in 9% of the patients and comprised two seminomas, one intratubular germ cell neoplasm with early stromal invasion, and a malignant sex cord tumor. At least one fallopian tube was present in 35% of the cases.
abstract_ja: 年齢14〜83歳（平均27歳）のアンドロゲン不応症候群（AIS）患者43例を検討した。40例が完全型、3例が不完全型AISであった。精巣の顕微鏡検査では、未熟な精細管が認められ、症例の28%では稀に精原細胞を含んでいた。大半の症例で顕著なライディッヒ細胞と卵巣間質に類似した紡錘形細胞の間質がみられた。精巣実質の構成は、びまん性管間質型、小葉状管間質型、混合管間質型、間質優位型の4型に分類された。過誤腫は63%、セルトリ細胞腺腫は23%の症例で認められた。悪性腫瘍は患者の9%で発生し、セミノーマ2例、早期の間質浸潤を伴う管内胚細胞腫瘍1例、悪性性索間質腫瘍1例であった。少なくとも1本の卵管が35%の症例で存在した。
